notes: Testimonial with 5-star rating, large quote marks and right-aligned attribution; multiple instances laid out in a 2-column masonry

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = quotation (optional first line with the rating, e.g. "★★★★★" or "5/5"), row 2 = attribution (author, location)

suitableFor: customer/owner reviews with a star rating
notSuitableFor: pull quotes without a rating (use quote)
